cases.known_gap: The Document model is a FLAT node list; a heading 'section' is an implicit range (h3..everything up to the next heading with level <= 2), not a single node or a children-bearing container. Single-target Move (as scoped in Phase B) cannot express 'move a section' without either (a) a MoveRange primitive taking a start/end id pair, or (b) the Planner decomposing this into N individual Move ops (h3, p3, bq1, h4, lst1) with the Applier preserving relative order. This case is scored qualitatively, not against a fixed expected answer — see harness README.
